title: Shore Beats Work 30A | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Short Walking Distance to Ed Walline Public Beach Access (700 Yards)* 4 Bicycles Included* All Bedrooms have Ensuite Baths* Private, Small Community - Only 15 Homes!* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attr
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Short Walking Distance to Ed Walline Public Beach Access (700 Yards)* 4 Bicycles Included* All Bedrooms have Ensuite Baths* Private, Small Community - Only 15 Homes!* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to assist further!Welcome to Shore Beats Work 30A, your perfect home away from home! This stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat is nestled in the Gulf Reflections community, just off Highway 30A near Gulf Place. Only a few blocks from the beach, this beautiful home features a bright, open living and dining area ideal for gathering with family and friends. Start your mornings in the fully equipped kitchen, complete with an extended breakfast bar, perfect for cooking and enjoying breakfast together. The first floor offers a comfortable guest bedroom with a queen bed, while the second floor features a spacious king master suite with private balcony access, a second guest bedroom with a queen bed, and a fun bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds — sleeping up to 10 guests comfortably. Every bedroom includes its own ensuite bathroom for added privacy and convenience. When you’re not relaxing indoors, take a dip in the community pool or enjoy a stroll to the nearby beach. Make unforgettable memories and enjoy the vacation of a lifetime at Shore Beats Work 30A!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed2nd Floor Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 3: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk BedsArea Attractions: The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A comprises 25 acres in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique among all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
